name: Seat Frame & Tubular Sub-Assembly
summary: Fixture-welded tube-frame sub-assemblies for vehicle seating, built to hold hole-to-hole geometry across the batch.
description: Welded tube-frame sub-assemblies for vehicle seating applications. Tube is cut and bent to profile, then located and joined on dedicated weld fixtures so that hole-to-hole geometry and frame squareness repeat unit to unit — the dimensions that decide whether the frame drops into your assembly line without rework. Supplied as a finished sub-assembly rather than loose components, removing an assembly operation from your own line. We manufacture this part family today for automotive seating programmes.
